Container.Name: nextrarr
Container.Overview:
nEXTrarr 0.2 — scans your Radarr/Sonarr libraries and helps you complete missing metadata: theme songs (theme.mp3), trailers (written to .nfo files), and extra artwork (clearlogo, clearart, banner, landscape, discart) from Fanart.tv and TMDB.
Next.js 16 + TypeScript + React + Prisma SQLite + shadcn/ui.
Features: - Full structured NFO editor (Form + Raw XML views) - Path traversal + SSRF protection (whitelisted artwork domains) - TTL cache on /api/media - Theme toggle (dark/light) — persisted - Self-healing DB schema (creates tables on first request via @prisma/client) - Optional Basic Auth via env vars - Multi-arch image (linux/amd64 + linux/arm64)
Setup: 1. Map /mnt/user to your Unraid media share (read-write). 2. Map /config to /mnt/user/appdata/nextrarr for persistent settings + DB. 3. Open WebUI (port 3000) — starts in DEMO mode automatically (12 mock movies). 4. Click Settings (gear icon) and configure: - Radarr URL + API key - Sonarr URL + API key (optional) - Fanart.tv API key (optional, for artwork) - TMDB API key (optional, for artwork) - Path mapping (e.g. Docker /movies -> Host /mnt/user/Movies) Tip: you can type the host path manually OR use the Sfoglia (Browse) button. 5. Save. Your real library will load.
For local testing without Docker Hub, build the image on Unraid: cd /mnt/user/appdata/nextrarr docker build -t nextrarr:local . docker run -d --name nextrarr --restart unless-stopped \ -p 3000:3000 \ -v /mnt/user/appdata/nextrarr:/config \ -v /mnt/user:/mnt/user:rw \ nextrarr:local

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the nEXTrarr web UI (container internal: 3000)

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent settings + SQLite database. Contains API keys — kept chmod 600 by entrypoint.

Config.Name: Media Root
Config.Description: Host media root (Unraid user share). Read-write so the app can save theme.mp3, artwork files, and NFO trailer tags.

Config.Name: Optional: Username
Config.Description: Leave empty to disable Basic Auth. Set together with EXTRARR_PASSWORD to enable HTTP Basic Auth on all endpoints.

Config.Name: Optional: Password
Config.Description: Leave empty to disable Basic Auth.

Config.Name: Allowed Prefixes
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed path prefixes for media access (defense-in-depth against path traversal). Default allows everything under /mnt and /data/media.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: DEBUG | INFO | WARNING | ERROR — controls verbosity of the Next.js server + entrypoint logs.

Config.Name: Demo Mode
Config.Description: Set to 1 to force mock data (12 movies + 4 TV shows) even when API keys are configured. Useful for UI testing without connecting real Radarr.
